title: Student Clash at Cachar College in Silchar
description: ABVP and NSUI supporters clashed at Cachar College in Silchar during a membership drive amid an ongoing hijab row, resulting in injuries to several students before police intervention.
actionSuggested: Increase police security around college campuses during student union drives and establish peace committees to prevent communal tensions.

title: Fatal Drowning Incident Near Annapurnaghat Bridge on Barak River
description: The bodies of a Silchar woman and her four-year-old son were recovered from the Barak river near Ganirgram after going missing following an incident near Annapurnaghat bridge.
actionSuggested: Inspect bridge pedestrian safety barriers, install warning signage, and deploy river rescue safety patrols along vulnerable stretches of the Barak river.

title: Attempted Sexual Assault on Student in Sribhumi Near Silchar
description: A 57-year-old man was arrested for an alleged rape attempt on a Class 10 student near Badarpur in Sribhumi, located within the Silchar region.
actionSuggested: Intensify police patrolling along school routes in Badarpur/Sribhumi and install adequate street lighting on secluded pathways.

title: Assam-Nagaland Border Tension in Golaghat District
description: Local residents in Golaghat district filed complaints following renewed tensions and incidents involving a Naga group along the Assam-Nagaland border.
actionSuggested: Deploy additional law enforcement patrols along sensitive border stretches in Golaghat and initiate inter-state administrative dialogue.

title: Student Clash and Injuries at Cachar College
description: A clash erupted between student groups at Cachar College in Silchar over a hijab-related issue, leaving several students injured.
actionSuggested: Increase security around college campuses in Silchar, facilitate peace dialogue with college authorities and student representatives, and ensure medical care for injured students.

title: Call for Scientific Flood Management Solutions Across Assam
description: Civil society forums in Assam are advocating for comprehensive and scientific engineering interventions to tackle persistent flood damages across affected river basins.
actionSuggested: Form a technical task force to review river embankment stability and implement modern hydrological flood management infrastructure.

title: Police Clash with Protesters in Patna
description: Police used water cannons and batons to control thousands of protesters who broke through security barricades during demonstrations in Bihar's capital.
actionSuggested: Deploy law enforcement for crowd control while establishing official dialogue channels to address public grievances safely.

title: Statewide Phase-Out of Office Plastic Waste in Gujarat
description: The Gujarat state government initiated a directive to replace plastic files and folders across all administrative offices with paper, jute, and cloth alternatives to decrease single-use plastic consumption.
actionSuggested: Procure sustainable paper and textile supplies for state departments and mandate regular waste compliance audits.

title: Proposed Mandatory Drug Screening for Commercial Pilots
description: India's aviation regulator is consulting stakeholders to mandate annual random drug testing for all commercial pilots following an Air India pilot testing positive for controlled substances after an incident.
actionSuggested: Enact mandatory random drug testing protocols across commercial airlines to improve public transport and aviation safety standards.
